preconditions.description: The number of students in the class is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
Each student's best friend is a valid student number within the class.
A student is not their own best friend.
Each student's sex is either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The number of pairs formed is equal to the number of pairs output.

postconditions.expression: e == sum(1 for a, b in pairs if sex[a-1] != sex[b-1])
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs is equal to the number of boy-girl pairs output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair contains valid student numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(pairs.count(pair) == 0 for pair in pairs for pairs in [postconditions])
postconditions.description: No student is included in more than one pair.

postconditions.expression: all(pairs.count((a, b)) == pairs.count((b, a)) for a, b in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair is listed twice in opposite order if it appears.
